lessons.body:
# Everything About Photosynthesis

## Learning Outcomes

- Understand photosynthesis.
- Know about chlorophyll and the light reactions.
- Explain the light reactions and evaluate their efficiency.

Photosynthesis is a process that happens in plants and it involves light and water and carbon dioxide and also chlorophyll which is green and sits inside the chloroplast and the chloroplast is inside the cell and the cell is inside the leaf and the leaf is on the plant and when light hits the chlorophyll the energy gets captured and then it moves through a chain of reactions that involve electrons and protons and various carrier molecules that shuttle things back and forth until eventually sugar comes out the other end along with oxygen which the plant releases into the air where animals breathe it in and then the animals breathe out carbon dioxide which the plant takes back in again and the whole thing keeps going round and round in a loop that has been running for billions of years without stopping even once.

STUDENTS MUST MEMORIZE EVERYTHING BEFORE PROCEEDING FURTHER.

Visual learners should watch the animation, while auditory learners should listen to the podcast version of this lesson instead.

Once you get up to speed this is really a piece of cake, and it boils down to a rule of thumb you can apply under the hood.
